values.note: 50 family campsites (picnic table, fire ring, tent pad), electric at the lower sites, plus double and group sites. Catalog max vehicle lengths 20-40 ft (most 25-35), a dozen pull-throughs. A railroad underpass on the FR 191 entrance limits vehicles to under 10 ft tall; taller campers use the Dahoga Road entrance from Wilcox, which has no height limit.

note: Allegheny NF campground at spring-fed Twin Lake (not the reservoir), eight miles southeast of Kane, with a swimming beach and fishing piers; run with the Friends of Twin Lakes. 50 family sites, 15-amp electric at the lower sites, vault toilets, dump station. Camping by donation (2026); request a site by phone (814-389-3019). A railroad underpass on the FR 191 entrance limits vehicles to under 10 ft tall: use the Dahoga Road entrance from Wilcox, which has no height limit. Near the lake, not lakefront. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 15-amp electric, reservable (by request). Changed platform operator -> phone; added donation-only fees (0/0), 50 sites to 40 ft with pull-throughs, no water/sewer at sites, vault toilets and dump, March 26 opening with fall weekends-only to late October, some first-come sites. Note corrected: the Dahoga Road entrance bypasses the 10-ft underpass. Not stated: potable water (the two official pages disagree).
